label: MUTABLE fork summary: immutable in one sense means no beginning, end or succession of life
rule: Uses agree from coverage and exclusivity; modus tollens on each use
meaning: Optional summary over MUTABLE_1-3. Coverage reads both uses of 'in potency in some respect' in the eternity step (succession, boundary) in selected senses; exclusivity makes them one sense. So whatever is not mutable in that one sense has neither succession nor a beginning or end of life. The controls give the mixed reading (succession MUTABLE_1, boundary MUTABLE_2): a being with no potency in itself, in another's power, begins to live, and the conclusion fails.
